subject.title: Explore Google Photos backup via Takeout or Data Portability API

question: Should gogcli pursue a supported Takeout-to-Drive ingestion primitive now, reserve a future command surface for Data Portability, or decline whole-library Photos backup as outside the core CLI scope?
rationale: The useful near-term path uses existing Drive delivery but introduces persistent state and backup-safety semantics, while a direct Data Portability implementation is currently blocked by the absence of a Photos resource and could add substantial OAuth-policy obligations. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/data-portability/user-guide/scopes?hl=en))

options.title: Feasibility document plus Drive ingestion
options.body: Document current API limits and design a narrow verified downloader for user-configured Takeout archives delivered to Drive.

options.title: Wait for a Photos portability resource
options.body: Keep the request tracked but defer implementation until Google officially exposes Google Photos through the Data Portability API.

options.title: Keep backup outside core
options.body: Decline a specialized workflow and document how users can compose existing Drive commands around manually configured Takeout exports.

recommendation.title: Feasibility document plus Drive ingestion
recommendation.body: Document current API limits and design a narrow verified downloader for user-configured Takeout archives delivered to Drive.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this account to the existing Photos feature and repository release direction across the affected command surfaces.
